items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I don't know if the Savoy wasn't running that place, strictly speaking. They could have been backers. I'm not sure. I'm not sure that they weren't. I never got mixed up in the business of the places.

ctx.x: So they were copying the Savoy in a sense.

I don't know if the Savoy wasn't running that place, strictly speaking. They could have been backers. I'm not sure. I'm not sure that they weren't. I never got mixed up in the business of the places. As long as the place was open and hired me, that's all I was interested in.
